definitions.explanation: Without patterns or designs; having only one color or no decorations.

examples.japanese: {無地|むじ}のTシャツを{買|か}った。
{無地|むじ}の{白|しろ}いシャツが{好|す}きだ。
{柄物|がらもの}より{無地|むじ}の{方|ほう}が{合|あ}わせやすい。
examples.english: Solid colors are easier to coordinate than patterned ones.

notes:
USAGE: Used as a noun or の-adjective to describe fabric, clothing, or items without patterns.

COMMON USAGE:
・{無地|むじ}のシャツ (plain shirt)
・{無地|むじ}の{壁紙|かべがみ} (plain wallpaper)
・{無地|むじ}の{封筒|ふうとう} (plain envelope)

CONTRAST:
・{柄|がら} - pattern
・{柄物|がらもの} - patterned item
・{チェック}{柄|がら} - checkered pattern
・{縞模様|しまもよう} - striped pattern

NOTE: The brand 無印良品 (Muji) derives its name from {無印|むじるし} (no brand mark).
